Offers both a death benefit and cash value growth.

narration: This policy is an Indexed Universal Life plan, designed for individuals like you, looking for flexible protection. It provides not only a valuable death benefit but also the potential for cash value growth over time.

title: Monthly Premium Breakdown

slideData.headline: Affordable Coverage
bullets: Less than the cost of your daily lunch.

narration: For just five hundred twenty dollars a month, you secure your family’s future. That's about sixteen dollars a day—less than the cost of your daily lunch. It's an affordable way to ensure your loved ones are protected.

title: Cash Value Growth

slideData.headline: Growing Your Investment
bullets: Projected to reach $84,900 by year ten.

narration: Your policy's cash value starts at one thousand eight hundred fifty dollars in the first year and is projected to grow significantly, reaching eighty-four thousand nine hundred dollars by year ten. This growth adds a safety net for your future financial needs.
slidePrompt: background with an upward trending graph

title: Surrender Values Explained

slideData.headline: Access to Funds
bullets: Access to cash value if needed.

narration: After five years, you could access up to twenty-four thousand dollars, providing liquidity if you ever need to tap into your cash value. This growing access to funds can be a crucial resource for you.
slidePrompt: background with a cash flow icon

title: Loan Rate Details
narration: You can take loans against your policy's cash value at a competitive rate of five percent. This gives you the flexibility to access funds when you need them, while still keeping your policy active.

title: Policy Riders Explained
narration: Your policy includes valuable riders like the Accelerated Death Benefit Rider, which allows access to the death benefit in case of terminal illness, and the Waiver of Premium Rider, ensuring your coverage continues even if you're unable to pay.
